resources.string: Finishing submitted requests. New changes and pending retries are paused.
A previous request has an unconfirmed result. Deletion has not been sent. Recovery records remain encrypted and changes remain paused.
The deletion result is unconfirmed. Changes and old requests remain paused. Retrying sends the same deletion request.
Server deletion is confirmed. Encrypted evidence is saved; local cleanup still needs to finish. Changes remain paused.
Server deletion is confirmed. Earlier requests remain as encrypted evidence and will not run again. Public-chain and financial records remain verifiable.
Too many pending requests to include in this deletion. Deletion was not sent; your records are preserved.
The server did not confirm the required deletion receipt. The result remains unconfirmed.
Deletion pauses earlier requests. Their original contents may remain as encrypted recovery evidence, including addresses. They will not run again after confirmed deletion.
